eyebrow: SQL Server Database Administration · Chapter Eight
subtitle: Lesson 47 · Linked Servers & Connectivity

code:
ping SQLSRV02
-- basic network reachability (not conclusive alone)

telnet SQLSRV02 1433
-- is anything listening & accepting on the port?

Refused/timeout here = firewall, stopped service,
or wrong port -- not a credentials problem.
caption: Isolate the network path from SQL Server itself before looking at logins.

code:
Default instance:  always TCP 1433
Named instance:    dynamic port

SQL Server Browser (UDP 1434)
resolves SQLSRV02\PROD -> actual port

Browser stopped = named-instance connections
can fail even though the instance is healthy.
caption: The fix is sometimes a completely different service than the one that seems broken.

steps.label: Firewall rules
steps.sub: must allow the Engine's TCP port + Browser's UDP 1434
